episode_row: first deploy-branch push fired no workflow (paths filter)

commits.subject: fix(ci): drop paths filter from deploy-branch trigger
commits.body:
First main:deploy push today silently skipped the canary workflow:
GitHub Actions evaluates the paths filter against a baseline it
can't meaningfully compare to a freshly-created branch, so no run
fired and canary had to be kicked via workflow_dispatch as fallback.

The deploy branch is a dedicated deploy ref — any push to it is an
intentional deploy — so path filtering there has no value and only
introduces this failure mode. Drop the filter; subsequent pushes to
deploy fire canary unconditionally.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
